profile.drive: the ram drives the profile: profile.t = clamp((ram.t - seat) / (ram.stroke - seat), 0, 1) * travel
profile.rule: profile-i (1-based) fades in once profile.t >= (i - 1) * segment; set every profile-i, since a missing id renders at full opacity

door.axis: world -z; built raised, t = drop closes it
